title: Find Array Given Subset Sums
goal: Recover an integer array from its multiset of subset sums.
strategy: The two smallest sums differ by the magnitude of one array element. Pair sums at that distance; the half containing zero determines whether to recover the positive or negative sign. Recurse on that half.
